short_meaning: You have a right only to perform your prescribed duty, but never to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of results, and never attach yourself to inaction.
practical_guidance: Focus 100% of your energy on the current study task or work step. When anxiety about exams or grades appears, gently bring your mind back to the line you are reading right now.
sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
transliteration:
Karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana
Mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stvakarmaṇi
meaning_en: You have a right only to perform your prescribed duty, but never to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of results, and never attach yourself to inaction.
meaning_hi: तुम्हारा अधिकार केवल कर्म करने में है, उसके फलों में कभी नहीं। इसलिए कर्म के फल के प्रति आसक्त मत हो और न ही तुम्हारी कर्म न करने में रुचि हो।
meaning_hinglish: Tumhara adhikar sirf karm karne par hai, uske result par nahi. Result ki chinta chhodkar imandari se kaam karo, aur alasi hokar ruk mat jao.
guidance_en: Focus 100% of your energy on the current study task or work step. When anxiety about exams or grades appears, gently bring your mind back to the line you are reading right now.
guidance_hi: जब पढ़ाई या परीक्षा को लेकर तनाव हो, तो केवल अभी किए जाने वाले एक काम पर ध्यान दें। परिणाम की चिंता छोड़ें और अपनी पूरी लगन कर्म में लगाएं।
guidance_hinglish: Exam ya career ki overthinking band karo. Apne samne jo chapter ya task hai, us par 100% focus do. Process par dhyan doge toh results apne aap aayenge.

short_meaning: Perform your duty with an even mind, abandoning all attachment to success or failure. Such equanimity of mind is called Yoga.
practical_guidance: Practice emotional stability. Treat a good day and a difficult day with the same calm attitude. Do not let one test score define your entire worth.
sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
transliteration:
Yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
Siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate
meaning_en: Perform your duty with an even mind, abandoning all attachment to success or failure. Such equanimity of mind is called Yoga.
meaning_hi: हे धनंजय! सफलता और विफलता में समान भाव रखकर, अनासक्त होकर अपने कर्तव्य का पालन करो। यही समभाव योग कहलाता है।
meaning_hinglish: Success mile ya failure, dono mein apna balance banaye rakho aur apna duty nibhao. Is mental balance ko hi Yoga kehte hain.
guidance_en: Practice emotional stability. Treat a good day and a difficult day with the same calm attitude. Do not let one test score define your entire worth.
guidance_hi: किसी भी परिस्थिति में अपना मानसिक संतुलन न खोएं। जीत हो या हार, शांत रहकर अपनी यात्रा जारी रखें।
guidance_hinglish: Ek test kharab ho gaya toh tutna nahi hai, aur accha ho gaya toh hawa mein nahi udna. Emotional stability maintain karo.

short_meaning: One who is endowed with wisdom frees oneself from both good and bad deeds in this life. Therefore, strive for Yoga, which is dexterity and skill in action.
practical_guidance: Turn work into craftsmanship. Don't rush through tasks stressed; take pride in clean, careful effort.
sanskrit:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्॥
transliteration:
Buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite
Tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam
meaning_en: One who is endowed with wisdom frees oneself from both good and bad deeds in this life. Therefore, strive for Yoga, which is dexterity and skill in action.
meaning_hi: समबुद्धि से युक्त व्यक्ति इसी जीवन में अच्छे और बुरे कर्मों के बंधन से मुक्त हो जाता है। इसलिए योग में लग जाओ, क्योंकि कर्मों में कुशलता ही योग है।
meaning_hinglish: Smart and balanced mind se kaam karo. Yoga ka matlab hai apne har kaam ko poori skill aur dedication ke saath karna.
guidance_en: Turn work into craftsmanship. Don't rush through tasks stressed; take pride in clean, careful effort.
guidance_hi: अपने हर काम को पूरी कुशलता और लगन से करें। जब काम पूरी एकाग्रता से होता है, तो मानसिक तनाव समाप्त हो जाता है।
guidance_hinglish: Har assignment aur task ko perfection aur focus ke saath complete karo. Kaam mein excellence laana hi sabse bada stress-buster hai.

short_meaning: Therefore, continuously perform obligatory duties without attachment; for by doing work without attachment, a person attains the highest goal.
practical_guidance: Show up every day even when motivation feels low. Action creates motivation, not the other way around.
sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः॥
transliteration:
Tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
Asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ
meaning_en: Therefore, continuously perform obligatory duties without attachment; for by doing work without attachment, a person attains the highest goal.
meaning_hi: इसलिए अनासक्त होकर निरंतर अपने कर्तव्य कर्म का भली-भांति पालन करो, क्योंकि अनासक्त होकर कर्म करने से मनुष्य परम गति को प्राप्त करता है।
meaning_hinglish: Bina kisi selfish attachment ke daily routine aur duty poori karo. Yahi discipline insan ko life ki top level tak le jaata hai.
guidance_en: Show up every day even when motivation feels low. Action creates motivation, not the other way around.
guidance_hi: प्रतिदिन अपनी दैनिक दिनचर्या और अध्ययन को बिना टालमटोल के जारी रखें। निरंतर प्रयास ही वास्तविक सफलता है।
guidance_hinglish: Motivation ka wait mat karo. Daily consistent effort lagao. Jab daily routine follow karoge, tab progress automatically dikhegi.

short_meaning: Surrendering all actions unto Me with your mind focused on the divine, free from desire, possessiveness, and mental fever, fight your battle.
practical_guidance: Release the heavy burden of carrying the whole world on your shoulders. Give your best effort and surrender the worry.
sanskrit:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।
निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः॥
transliteration:
Mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā
Nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ
meaning_en: Surrendering all actions unto Me with your mind focused on the divine, free from desire, possessiveness, and mental fever, fight your battle.
meaning_hi: अपने सभी कर्मों को मुझे समर्पित करके, आध्यात्म चेतना के साथ, आशा, ममता और मानसिक संताप से मुक्त होकर अपने जीवन का युद्ध लड़ो।
meaning_hinglish: Apne saare bojh aur chintayein bhagwan ko saup do. Ego aur overthinking chhodkar bina ghabraye apne challenges face karo.
guidance_en: Release the heavy burden of carrying the whole world on your shoulders. Give your best effort and surrender the worry.
guidance_hi: मानसिक बोझ को हल्का करें। अपने हिस्से का श्रेष्ठ कर्म करें और परिणाम को ईश्वर पर छोड़ दें।
guidance_hinglish: Duniya bhar ka tension sir par leke mat ghumo. Apni taraf se poori koshish karo aur baaki universe ke haath mein chhod do.

short_meaning: By worshipping that supreme source from whom all beings originate, through one's own natural duty, a person attains supreme perfection.
practical_guidance: Do what aligns with your natural abilities with utmost sincerity. Respect your unique journey.
sanskrit:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः॥
transliteration:
Yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
Sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ
meaning_en: By worshipping that supreme source from whom all beings originate, through one's own natural duty, a person attains supreme perfection.
meaning_hi: जिससे संपूर्ण प्राणियों की उत्पत्ति हुई है और जिससे यह सब व्याप्त है, उस ईश्वर की अपने स्वाभाविक कर्म द्वारा अर्चना करके मनुष्य सिद्धि पाता है।
meaning_hinglish: Apne natural talent aur honest work ko hi prayer bana lo. Apne duty ko sincerely karna hi sabse bada spiritual work hai.
guidance_en: Do what aligns with your natural abilities with utmost sincerity. Respect your unique journey.
guidance_hi: अपने स्वभाव के अनुकूल कार्य को पूरी निष्ठा से करें। तुलना करने के बजाय अपने विकास पर ध्यान दें।
guidance_hinglish: Dusro se compare mat karo. Jo tumhara subject ya craft hai, usme apna best do. Sincere hard work hi tumhari pooja hai.

short_meaning: O son of Kunti, the contact between the senses and their objects gives rise to cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They are fleeting and temporary; learn to endure them patiently.
practical_guidance: Remember that emotional low phases are temporary waves. Acknowledge the tough feelings, breathe through them, and know that clarity returns.
sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत॥
transliteration:
Mātrā-sparśhās tu kaunteya śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ
Āgamāpāyino 'nityās tans-titikṣhasva bhārata
meaning_en: O son of Kunti, the contact between the senses and their objects gives rise to cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They are fleeting and temporary; learn to endure them patiently.
meaning_hi: हे कुंतीपुत्र! इंद्रियों और विषयों का संपर्क सर्दी-गर्मी और सुख-दुःख देने वाला है। ये आने-जाने वाले और अनित्य हैं, इसलिए हे भारत, इन्हें सहन करना सीखो।
meaning_hinglish: Khushi aur gham, thand aur garmi jaise temporary hain. Ye waqt bhi beet jayega. Thoda patience aur sahan-shakti rakho.
guidance_en: Remember that emotional low phases are temporary waves. Acknowledge the tough feelings, breathe through them, and know that clarity returns.
guidance_hi: कठिन समय और उदासी स्थायी नहीं है। जैसे मौसम बदलते हैं, वैसे ही मन की स्थिति भी बदलती है। धैर्य बनाए रखें।
guidance_hinglish: Sadness aur stress temporary phase hai. Yeh hamesha ke liye nahi rehne wala. Deep breath lo aur calm raho, sab theek ho jayega.

short_meaning: One whose mind is undisturbed in sorrow, who is free from longing in pleasure, and who is devoid of passion, fear, and anger, is called a person of steady wisdom.
practical_guidance: Observe your emotions without reacting instantly. When anger or fear rises, wait 5 minutes before making any decision.
sanskrit:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते॥
transliteration:
Duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ
Vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate
meaning_en: One whose mind is undisturbed in sorrow, who is free from longing in pleasure, and who is devoid of passion, fear, and anger, is called a person of steady wisdom.
meaning_hi: जिसका मन दुःखों में व्याकुल नहीं होता, जो सुखों में ललचाता नहीं, और जो राग (आसक्ति), भय और क्रोध से मुक्त है, वही स्थिर बुद्धि मुनि कहलाता है।
meaning_hinglish: Jo gham mein tutata nahi aur khushi mein behakta nahi, jisko darr aur gussa control nahi karte, wahi asli mentally strong person hai.
guidance_en: Observe your emotions without reacting instantly. When anger or fear rises, wait 5 minutes before making any decision.
guidance_hi: क्रोध या भय के क्षणों में तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया न दें। कुछ पल शांत रहें और मन को स्थिर होने दें।
guidance_hinglish: Jab bhi gussa ya fear aye, turant react mat karo. 5 minute shaant baitho aur deep breathing karo. Clarity turant aayegi.

short_meaning: Elevate yourself through the power of your mind, and do not degrade yourself. For the mind can be your greatest friend, and also your greatest enemy.
practical_guidance: Notice how you talk to yourself. Replace self-criticism with encouraging, constructive self-talk.
sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
transliteration:
Uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
Ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
meaning_en: Elevate yourself through the power of your mind, and do not degrade yourself. For the mind can be your greatest friend, and also your greatest enemy.
meaning_hi: अपने मन द्वारा अपना उद्धार करो और अपने आप को नीचे मत गिराओ। क्योंकि मन ही मनुष्य का सच्चा मित्र है और मन ही उसका सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है।
meaning_hinglish: Apne mind ko train karke apna dost banao, dushman nahi. Tum khud hi apne sabse bade supporter ban sakte ho ya apne sabse bade critic.
guidance_en: Notice how you talk to yourself. Replace self-criticism with encouraging, constructive self-talk.
guidance_hi: अपने प्रति कठोर न बनें। अपनी कमियों को स्वीकार करते हुए स्वयं को आगे बढ़ने की प्रेरणा दें।
guidance_hinglish: Negative self-talk band karo. Jaise ek dost ko encourage karte ho, waise hi khud ko support karo. Tumhara mind tumhara best friend banega.

short_meaning: For those who have conquered the mind, it is their best friend. But for those who have failed to do so, the mind remains an enemy.
practical_guidance: Build self-mastery through small habits: set a bedtime, reduce doomscrolling, and drink water.
sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
transliteration:
Bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
Anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat
meaning_en: For those who have conquered the mind, it is their best friend. But for those who have failed to do so, the mind remains an enemy.
meaning_hi: जिसने अपने मन पर विजय प्राप्त कर ली है, उसका मन उसका सबसे अच्छा मित्र है। परंतु जो मन को नहीं जीत सका, उसके लिए मन शत्रु के समान कार्य करता है।
meaning_hinglish: Jisne apne mind aur habits ko control kar liya, uska mind uska best ally hai. Warna distracted mind dushman jaisa behave karta hai.
guidance_en: Build self-mastery through small habits: set a bedtime, reduce doomscrolling, and drink water.
guidance_hi: छोटी-छोटी अच्छी आदतों से मन को अनुशासित करें। फोन का स्क्रीन टाइम कम करें और दिनचर्या नियमित रखें।
guidance_hinglish: Social media scrolling aur distractions ko limit karo. Chhoti habits se mind ko discipline mein laoge toh stress khatam hoga.

short_meaning: Wherever the restless and unsteady mind wanders, one should repeatedly bring it back under the control of the Self.
practical_guidance: Do not be frustrated when your mind drifts during study. Every time you notice it wandering, gently redirect it without guilt.
sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
transliteration:
Yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
Tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet
meaning_en: Wherever the restless and unsteady mind wanders, one should repeatedly bring it back under the control of the Self.
meaning_hi: यह चंचल और अस्थिर मन जिस-जिस विषय की ओर भागे, उसे वहां-वहां से रोककर बार-बार अंतःकरण में ही स्थिर करना चाहिए।
meaning_hinglish: Chanchal mind jahan-jahan bhatak kar overthinking mein jaye, wahan se gently use wapas apne kaam aur center par le aao.
guidance_en: Do not be frustrated when your mind drifts during study. Every time you notice it wandering, gently redirect it without guilt.
guidance_hi: पढ़ाई के दौरान जब मन भटके, तो निराश न हों। प्रेमपूर्वक और धैर्य से ध्यान को वापस पढ़ाई पर लाएं।
guidance_hinglish: Agar padhai karte time dhyan bhatke toh gussa mat karo. Shant hokar book par wapas aao. Ye practice hi focus banati hai.

short_meaning: Lord Krishna said: O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is indeed restless and hard to master. But by regular practice (Abhyasa) and detachment (Vairagya), it can be restrained.
practical_guidance: Mastering concentration takes practice like a muscle. Set a 25-minute Pomodoro timer and practice single-tasking.
sanskrit:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
transliteration:
Asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam
Abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate
meaning_en: Lord Krishna said: O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is indeed restless and hard to master. But by regular practice (Abhyasa) and detachment (Vairagya), it can be restrained.
meaning_hi: श्री भगवान बोले: हे महाबाहु कुंतीपुत्र! इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं कि मन चंचल और कठिनता से वश में आने वाला है, परंतु हे कौन्तेय! अभ्यास और वैराग्य से इसे वश में किया जा सकता है।
meaning_hinglish: Shri Krishna kehte hain: Mind bhatakna normal hai, par continuous practice (Abhyasa) aur faltu chintaon ko chhodne (Vairagya) se ye control mein aa jata hai.
guidance_en: Mastering concentration takes practice like a muscle. Set a 25-minute Pomodoro timer and practice single-tasking.
guidance_hi: एकाग्रता एक दिन में नहीं आती, यह अभ्यास से बनती है। प्रतिदिन 20 मिनट बिना किसी भटकाव के पढ़ने का अभ्यास करें।
guidance_hinglish: Mind ko ek din mein master nahi kiya ja sakta. Daily 25 minute ka focus session lagao. Consistency hi mind ko shant karegi.

short_meaning: Yoga is difficult to attain for one with an uncontrolled mind; but one who strives with disciplined effort and proper means can surely achieve it.
practical_guidance: Structure your day with small routines: consistent wake-up time, journaling, and dedicated study blocks.
sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः॥
transliteration:
Asaṁyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
Vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo 'vaptum upāyataḥ
meaning_en: Yoga is difficult to attain for one with an uncontrolled mind; but one who strives with disciplined effort and proper means can surely achieve it.
meaning_hi: जिसका मन वश में नहीं है, उसके लिए योग पाना कठिन है, परंतु जिसने मन को वश में कर लिया है, वह सही उपायों द्वारा इसे अवश्य पा लेता है।
meaning_hinglish: Bina discipline ke mental peace pana mushkil hai, par right methods aur daily routine follow karne se mental mastery pakka mil sakti hai.
guidance_en: Structure your day with small routines: consistent wake-up time, journaling, and dedicated study blocks.

guidance_hinglish: Ek clear schedule banao. Jab tumhara routine fix hoga, toh overthinking ke liye time hi nahi bachega.

short_meaning: Do not yield to unmanliness, O Partha; it does not befit you. Shake off this trivial weakness of heart and arise, O conqueror of foes!
practical_guidance: When you feel like giving up, remember your inner strength. Stand up, wash your face, and face the challenge head-on.

guidance_en: When you feel like giving up, remember your inner strength. Stand up, wash your face, and face the challenge head-on.

guidance_hinglish: Nirash hokar bistar par mat lete raho. Apni himmat ko jagao, utho aur apne target par kaam shuru karo. Tum mein bohot potential hai.

short_meaning: In this path of selfless action, no effort is ever lost and there is no adverse result. Even a little practice of this path protects one from great fear.
practical_guidance: Even 10 minutes of study or one positive habit completed today builds permanent momentum. No good effort is wasted.
sanskrit:

meaning_hi: इस निष्काम कर्मयोग में आरंभ का नाश नहीं होता और न कोई उल्टा परिणाम होता है। इसका थोड़ा सा भी आचरण मनुष्य को बड़े भय से रक्षा करता है।
meaning_hinglish: Positive effort kabhi bekar nahi jata. Chhota sa bhi sincere effort aur right mindset insan ko bade se bade fear se bacha leta hai.
guidance_en: Even 10 minutes of study or one positive habit completed today builds permanent momentum. No good effort is wasted.

guidance_hinglish: Har chhota step count hota hai. Agar aaj sirf 20 minute bhi padha ya exercise kiya, toh wo bhi progress hai. Koi effort waste nahi hota.

short_meaning: Perform your prescribed duties, for action is superior to inaction. Even the maintenance of the physical body is not possible without action.
practical_guidance: Beat procrastination by doing. Taking imperfect action right now is 100 times better than waiting for perfect conditions.
sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः॥

meaning_hinglish: Action hamesha inaction se better hai. Sirf sochte rehne se kuch nahi badalta, chhota sa action lene se life aage badhti hai.
guidance_en: Beat procrastination by doing. Taking imperfect action right now is 100 times better than waiting for perfect conditions.
guidance_hi: टालमटोल से बचें। सोचने में समय गंवाने के बजाय काम शुरू करें। पहला कदम उठाते ही रास्ता साफ दिखने लगता है।
guidance_hinglish: Sochna band karo aur kaam shuru karo. Ek chhota step lene se saari lethargy aur laziness door ho jaati hai.

meaning_en: While contemplating sense objects, attachment to them develops. From attachment arises longing, and from unfulfilled longing arises anger.

meaning_hinglish: Jab hum kisi cheez ke baare mein lagatar overthink karte hain, toh attachment banta hai. Aur jab wo wish poori nahi hoti, toh frustration aur anger aata hai.

short_meaning: From anger arises delusion; from delusion comes loss of memory. Loss of memory ruins intellect; and through ruin of intellect, a person is destroyed.
practical_guidance: Never send an angry text, make an important decision, or give up when angry. Walk away, drink a glass of water, and let calm return.
